description: Run a process diagram (flowchart, swimlane or BPMN made earlier) through AI Flowchart's process simulator — a real discrete-event simulation, not an AI guess — to find how long each case takes, the cost per case, how busy each team is and where the bottleneck is, with a suggestion. Use it when the user asks how long a process takes, where it gets stuck, how many staff they need, or what happens at a given volume. Pass the numbers the user gives (cases per day, people per team, minutes per step); anything missing uses clear defaults that are listed in the answer. Returns the results plus a link that opens the simulator on the diagram. Free — no AI credits.

cases_per_day.description: New cases (orders, tickets, claims…) arriving per working day. Default 20.

cost_per_hour.description: Staff cost per hour, in the user's currency. Default 20.

diagram.description: Link (https://aiflowchart.io/import/<id>) or id of a flowchart, swimlane or BPMN diagram made earlier.

staff.description: People per lane/team, as the user said. Swimlanes: one entry per lane name. Flowcharts: a single entry for the whole team.

lane.description: Lane / team name as on the diagram.

step_minutes.description: How long steps take, in minutes of work, as the user said. Optional min/max for a range.

step.description: Step label as on the diagram.

name: simulate_process
title: Simulate a process
